capabilities: Set tempo from 30 to 240 BPM by typing, slider, steppers, or tap tempo
Configure 1-8 beats per measure with accent, normal, and mute per beat
Choose quarter, eighth, triplet, or sixteenth subdivisions
Run open-ended or countdown practice sessions with measure and progress display
Save and apply up to 12 named presets of tempo, rhythm, and sound settings
extras: Sounds are synthesized locally via Web Audio with no audio assets or network requests; the interface is always in English regardless of system language.
problem: Musicians practicing with their notes in Obsidian have no built-in metronome and must switch to a separate app or device.
summary: Sidebar metronome for music practice with a tempo dial, rhythm accents, subdivisions, synthesized sounds, and timed practice sessions.
